messages:
Sam: Hey finance — need a quick deal-desk ok. Marina Logistics wants a 3-month pilot at 25% off list for Dedicated capacity (they'll commit to ~120k tokens/day). Deal is time-sensitive, legal okayed demo, they need an invoice sent today for the pilot. PO incoming.
Ava: Quick questions — what's the current list MRR and expected billed amount for the 3 months? Also attach the proposed PO or language. 25% is kinda high for a pilot without a long-term commit.
Sam: List price for the pilot would be $36k/month. With 25% off it's $27k/month => $81k for 3 months. They sign PO for pilot only, no commit beyond. Reason: large ops team, competitor quoted 30% off with trial.
Priya: Adding context from AE: Marina asked for a short-term price to move now; they are strategic in EMEA and we have a renew upsell motion if pilot shows perf. They didn't want credits — they insisted on an invoice for procurement reasons.
Ava: Can we structure as refundable credit if they convert to a 12mo Dedicated commit? That reduces risk.
Sam: They won't accept refundable credits — procurement requires an invoice and that shows in their audit. We're trying to avoid losing them.
Marco: FYI — discount >20% needs RevOps + CFO approval per policy. Also need to sign off on billing code so we can track as "pilot-discount" for analytics.
Lena: Legal: if Finance approves, send the modified SOW with clause: "Pilot pricing applies for initial 3 months only; conversion to committed pricing requires a separate agreement." Also add limitation on liability and data handling language before we finalize.
BillingBot: billing-bot created invoice INV-2026-0457 in draft for $27,000/month and attached to thread. Link: https://billing.internal/invoices/INV-2026-0457
Ava: I ran a quick margin calc — expected gross margin at 25% off is still positive but small if usage spikes. Need an explicit cap on tokens to avoid overage losses (e.g., cap to 150k tokens/day or automatic re-rate). Can sales get that accepted by the customer?
Sam: I'll confirm cap. AE will request the cap in the PO amendment and push procurement to accept automatic re-rate beyond cap.
Diego: (CFO) I'm okay to sign off conditionally: approve up to 20% pilot discount for 3 months if we get the token cap and the SOW language Lena suggested. For 25% we need Exec Rev sign-off — Sam pls escalate to me with strategic rationale and ACV upside.
Sam: Got it — escalating now. Sending exec note with ARR lift rationale and regional priority. Thanks.
Priya: Noted — I'll tag the invoice with "pilot-discount" and set a monthly check to reconcile usage vs cap.
Ava: Once Diego confirms, I'll finalize the invoice and post the credit memo process if they later convert.
Sam: Thanks all. I'll post the PO amendment and ping again. :thumbsup:
